title: Superintendent
description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners of the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives, which include educational scholarships, agricultural support and health outreach programs, help to improve the quality of life and build long-term capacity in local communities.
Key Accountabilities
This position is responsible for leading engagement activities, supporting dispute resolution, promoting compliance with company policies and procedures, assisting in the coordination of community development, attending to and resolving community incidents/grievances. Part of the responsibilities include:
Lead Community Affairs Operations:
Manage daily activities, team performance, and budgets to deliver effective community engagement programs
.
Stakeholder & Landowner Engagement: A
ct as primary liaison with landowners, youth, and local communities to foster trust, manage relationships, and resolve conflicts.
Grievance & Risk Management:
Oversee the grievance system, monitor emerging threats, and work with security teams to ensure operational stability.
Cultural & Social Inclusion:
Promote cultural awareness, support engagement with women and youth, and educate staff on local customs and social dynamics.
Compensation & Compliance Oversight:
Coordinate landowner compensation, occupation fees, and ensure alignment with legal, policy, and human rights standards.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Work closely with internal departments and government officials to address landowner issues and deliver shared outcomes.
About You
To be considered for this position, candidates must have substantial experience in a similar role, preferably within Papua New Guinea or in a culturally diverse setting. In addition to this, candidates should also be able to demonstrate and have some or all of the following:
Tertiary qualifications in a relevant field such as Community Development, Communications for Development, Human Resources, or related disciplines.
PNG Driver’s license Class 6 is essential given the need for the driving is critical in this role
Proficient in English and Tok Pinis (Pidgin), both spoken and written.
Competency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly MS Word and Excel.
Effective interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
Experience in conflict resolution and managing potentially tense or volatile community situations
Skilled in change management and community relations strategy implementation.
Ability to supervise and motivate teams to achieve community and company goals.
Sound knowledge of occupational health and safety practise relevant to community engagement and field work
Life at K92
Our core values — Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, and Safety — are central to our operations and fundamental to our success. K92 upholds a commitment to equal opportunity, striving to ensure that every individual can reach their highest potential without experiencing discrimination.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
We believe in sharing our success with our employees. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer participation in long- and short-term incentive plans. We also offer savings programs, medical assistance, as well as access to our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
If you share our values and are looking for your next career step, come join us on this exciting journey. Submit your application through our website today.
